title: The Icterine
description: Watch results for the Icterine — a reach of spined waves, drilling rigs, and temple-stone.

prompts.text: A field of deep purple blooms, soft on the hull and smelling of honeysuckle.
Tame catekora nose at the hull, their old racing-collars faded and torn.
A rousing worker's cry carries across the spined waves from a nearby drilling rig.
A day of crushing heat, sapping strength and sending the undercrew belowdecks to relax.
The skeleton of a pinned sailor, fixed to the ironspine waves even now.
The shadow of a stone ship passes over you, far larger than your own vessel.
A cactus-drilling rig in the midst of a shutdown; the workers play dice and relax in the shade.
A tent colony staked to the carved walls of a slumping temple, barely above the upper tangle.
A silken airship of mothryn marauders, blades-for-hire currently between jobs.
A failed rig, skeletal and rusting.
Temple-stone traders in a ceramic barge, on the run from the Tricenturi.
A rig-defence vessel that has identified you as a potential threat to the Consortium.
A winding river of sand defies the accepted laws of nature, drifting past the ship like a golden ribbon.
A burst of growth from the ironspines cages the ship within a spiked, fibrous barrier.
Scarabs and rainbow-bodied beetles crawl over an abandoned crate stamped with faded Consortium markings.
A sandstorm spins itself into existence far to the east, heading your way and changing course to match yours.
A scatter of blooms hiding a yawning rift.
A temple-worm rears beneath the ship, wounded by the prow and looking for revenge.
